content: Our basic model for RUN is a sequence-to-sequence model similar to the work of BIBREF19 on SAIL, and inspired by BIBREF20. It is based on Conditioned Generation with Attention (CGA). To this model we added an Entity abstraction layer (CGAE) and a World-state representation (CGAEW). It thus consists of six components we describe in turn – Encoder, Decoder, Attention, Entity Abstraction, World-State Processor, Execution-System. The complete architecture is depicted in Fig. FIGREF7.
